headline: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
summary: The Australian stock market extended its early losses in mid-market trading on Tuesday, adding to losses from the previous three sessions. The move followed broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight.
why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark index, tracking the country's largest listed companies across banking, mining and healthcare.
why_moved: The index extended its losses after broadly negative overnight cues from Wall Street, following three prior sessions of decline.
